title: Desk phone screen is blank, no dial tone
symptom: The desk phone has a blank screen and no dial tone
user_description: My desk phone is dead. The screen is black and when I pick it up there's no dial tone at all. I moved my desk things around this morning, if that matters.

options.why: A dead screen usually means no power, not a broken phone. Check the cable first.
The desk phone works on its own. Restarting the PC does not change the phone.

options.text: Tell him to use his mobile for now
options.why: That leaves the problem unfixed, and his callers still cannot reach his desk number.

options.text: Check the phone's network cable at the phone and at the wall port, and push it back in if it is loose
options.why: This office's phones are internet (VoIP) phones that get their power through the network cable. A loose cable means no power, so a blank screen and no dial tone.

hints: Does the phone show any lights at all?
How does this office's phone get its power?
He moved things on his desk this morning.
real_world_tip: Many office phones are VoIP phones powered through the network cable (called PoE, Power over Ethernet). Others use a separate power adapter, so check which kind your office has.
